caption:
The level of detail in this cyberpunk metropolis is breathtaking. Every neon sign and wet pavement brick was placed by hand to create this immersive urban labyrinth. It’s fascinating how much personality these tiny structures can hold... even if one little resident seems quite grumpy about being moved around today.

#miniature #diorama #modelmaking #cyberpunk #craftsmanship #miniatureworld
